title: Developers Community
text: In this meetup, we will explore how developers can transform payment integrations into real and profitable solutions for the food service segment (bars, restaurants, and others). We will explore how modern payment platforms have evolved from simple transaction processors to intelligent decision hubs, capable of directly impacting conversion, average ticket, recurrence, and retention, both in delivery and in-person consumption.
